test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Why did John remain steadfast in his traditional farming methods?

options.text: He was afraid of changing and could not invest.
He believed that hard work and patience were the keys to success.
He was too old to learn new techniques.
He didn’t have enough money to invest in modern equipment.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage states that John stuck to traditional methods** "believing in hard work and patience."**
 
• This belief is explicitly mentioned as his reason for adhering to traditional farming techniques.
 
• In summary,** option 2** accurately reflects John's motivations as described in the passage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **He was afraid of changing and could not invest:** The passage does not suggest that John was afraid of change or that financial constraints were a reason for his choices.
 
• **He was too old to learn new techniques:** The passage does not mention John’s age as a reason for his decision to stick with traditional methods.
 
• **He didn’t have enough money to invest in modern equipment:** There is no indication in the passage that lack of money influenced John's decision to stick to traditional farming techniques.
